prompt: Built-in imagegen: nine early prehistoric finds braced at weak points in a square 3x3 warm-ivory paper and matte-gouache swatch. Cells: scraper with soft grip, contrasting stone path with branch brace, tied root join, animal-like natural rock, hand-rolled drill branch, braced reed pouring water, stone smoothing groove, bark supporting hide fold, bound twig lifting ember.

entries.review: Top-left: sharp irregular flint scraper protected by rough soft hide at its thin middle.
Top-middle: bare path indicated by contrasting loose stones and a rough branch bridging weak ground.
Top-right: two unlike roots joined by a single short coarse fiber tie at the weak point.
Middle-left: natural cracked rock vaguely suggests a crouching animal, with fractured corner propped by a stone.
Middle-middle: hands rolling a plain branch into a shallow wood hollow, no bow drill.
Middle-right: hollow reed pours a narrow stream into cracked stone basin with a second reed bracing it.
Bottom-left: handstone rubbing a shallow groove in sandstone while another pebble supports its edge.
Bottom-middle: curved bark supports a folded raw-hide scrap, secured only by a crude fiber tie.
Bottom-right: forked twig carrying a tiny ember away from the hand, weak split tied with grass.
